# TreeList

> TreeList (treelist.ai) is a directory of tree service companies, organized by city and service. It is not a tree service company: it does not employ crews, own equipment or do tree work. Homeowners can send a free quote request from any city page, and TreeList routes it to a local company that serves their ZIP code. Paid placements are labeled "Featured" or "Exclusive" on the page. TreeList does not publish star ratings, invented company names or city-specific prices.

## Live cities
- [Dayton, OH](https://treelist.ai/dayton-oh/)
- [Pittsburgh, PA](https://treelist.ai/pittsburgh-pa/)

- [Des Moines, IA](https://treelist.ai/des-moines-ia/)
- [Winston-Salem, NC](https://treelist.ai/winston-salem-nc/)
- [Wichita, KS](https://treelist.ai/wichita-ks/)
- [Syracuse, NY](https://treelist.ai/syracuse-ny/)

## Services (each live city has a page per service)
- Tree service: assessment, pruning, removal and cleanup, e.g. [Dayton](https://treelist.ai/dayton-oh/tree-service/)
- Tree removal: taking a tree down, rigging, haul-off and cleanup, e.g. [Dayton](https://treelist.ai/dayton-oh/tree-removal/)
- Stump grinding: grinding a stump below grade, e.g. [Dayton](https://treelist.ai/dayton-oh/stump-grinding/)
- Tree trimming: pruning for clearance, shape, storm readiness or deadwood, e.g. [Dayton](https://treelist.ai/dayton-oh/tree-trimming/)
- Emergency tree service: storm damage or a tree on a structure or road, e.g. [Dayton](https://treelist.ai/dayton-oh/emergency-tree-service/)

## How it works
- A quote request collects name, phone, email, ZIP, service type and timing, and is routed to a company that covers that ZIP.
- Standard listings are free. Featured and Exclusive spots are paid placements and are labeled as such on the page.
- Cost guidance is a published national range (Angi 2026: tree removal typically $200 to $2,000+, about $750 on average), not a city survey.
